reuse.why: Builds on the existing linkBankSyncAccount and link.findOrCreateBank helpers for all providers, including Fintegra, but releaseBankAccount re-implements the unlink field reset instead of sharing it with unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The assertBankAccountNotLinked call block is repeated in all six provider functions, the 'held by another account' query appears in both assert and release, releaseBankAccount copies unlinkAccount's update, and the Fintegra download/accounts functions copy Akahu's/others'.

placement.why: Link rules live in accounts/link.ts and provider wiring in app.ts/sync.ts as the tree does, though the take-over is split between the per-provider assert and the shared linkBankSyncAccount.

scope.why: Covers the four steps; adds a client listing handler and UI provider entries beyond the server-only request, plus an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: The link preconditions are centralised in one helper, but replaceExistingLink must be threaded through every provider into two places and the unlink reset now has two copies that can drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: link.ts releaseBankAccount resets the account columns itself instead of reusing the unlink logic in app.ts unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: releaseBankAccount is unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount reset reshaped as a loop over holders; its holder query is the assert's query reused as db.all.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink with an if-branch that releases the old holder; assertBankAccountNotLinked takes replaceExistingLink with an early-return branch; processBankSyncDownload's akahu branch gains a fintegra special case; releaseBankAccount re-implements unlinkAccount's reset.
